entries.reason: owed: coordination/api-queue.md names this row. A 27.0 name cannot appear in a 26.2 surface by construction, so what this needs is a NEWER SURFACE that declares it
entries.effect: NOT carried: the queue dates this 27.0 but the SDK 26.2 surface does not declare it, so there is no declaration here to read the signature from, and carrying a member on a remembered signature would be a guess with a symbol on it
entries.source: SDK 26.2 surface, UIKit (via=own); the band's object compiled for armv7-apple-ios6.1.3 and read with otool -v -s __TEXT __objc_classname and __objc_methname, which is the count the registry check makes
